From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite workshop — travel variance & procurement plan for OptiHealth

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Quick summary: OptiHealth confirmed a two-day onsite workshop in Boston (May 12–13). Travel plan from the account asks for an early arrival night (May 11) so we can do AV run and an executive dinner the evening prior. Their room block opens late and the cheapest available flights force a Friday evening arrival which would break the team's prep window.

Ask: I need an approval for a one-night exception to our travel policy (overnight before workshop) for three Redwood attendees: myself, Samir (SE), and Joel (AM). Estimated delta vs. policy-compliant travel is $1,260 for hotel + $420 additional flight premium; total $1,680. I attached the cost estimate and the workshop agenda.

Proposed procurement path: split 60/40 (OptiHealth cover 60% via SOW credit, Redwood pays remaining 40%). OptiHealth procurement has verbally agreed but needs our internal budget sign-off + a PO or DocuSign addendum.

If you can confirm cost center and route (procurement vs. direct-card), I’ll kick off the booking and submit the policy-exception form.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0139
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear numbers. A couple quick asks before I sign off:

- Can we push for one of the lower-tier hotels in the same block? The estimate seems to be based on the premium property.
- Confirm attendees by name + titles so procurement forms list correct travelers.
- Please add the HubSpot Deal link and SOW clause that promises the 60% coverage. I’ll loop Marcus for budget sign-off.

If OptiHealth will put the 60% on their PO, we should be fine to use the corporate card for the 40% and then expense reconcile. Otherwise we need a formal PO/DocuSign addendum before we front any spend.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/8791

—Ben

Thanks all — reviewed the numbers. I’m comfortable approving the incremental spend from EP-OPS-44 up to $2,000 provided:

1) We receive a signed statement from OptiHealth committing to the 60% SOW credit (email or PO).
2) Vanessa completes the travel policy-exception form and certifies that the extra night is required for AV setup and executive dinner.

I’ve attached the policy-exception form — Vanessa, please complete and submit it to procurement@redwood.com. Once that’s in, procurement will issue a short PO or we’ll attach an addendum to the existing SOW (whichever OptiHealth prefers).
